name: 54482 · Stevens Point, WI
findings: ZIP 54482 (Stevens Point) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54482 (Stevens Point) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 54482 (Stevens Point) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
